releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.13.1 - Full Cooling System & AI Fan Overhaul:
- Synchronized all cooling profiles (AI Smart, Max Turbo, Silent Whisper, Auto) directly with HP WMI BIOS registers.
- Fixed RPM telemetry calculation so tachometer gauges, percentages, and duty cycles match applied fan modes in real-time.
- Unlocked full 100% PWM Turbo Mode (~5,400 RPM) for Max Fan mode.
- Enhanced AI Cooling Governor with proactive predictive PID scaling and whisper idle floor (~1,650 RPM).
